title: Para Bellum content: the aggregation rules
description: How each division stat is derived from its companies, one row per stat. File: Content/<namespace>/aggregation.json, exactly ONE across every namespace. Which collisions exist is the point of this file: a wrong rule is invisible in the numbers and obvious here, so an unknown rule, an unknown stat, a missing stat and a subset selecting nothing are all refused. The arithmetic is exact: docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

stat.description: A division stat in Content/vocabulary.json (C410). One row each (C203, C916).

subset.description: Which of a division's companies it reads: line, support or all. all includes the hq column. Something else, or a column no template uses, selects nothing (C917).

max_weight_per_mille.description: Required on max_mean_blend, and only there (C919): the weight of the maximum, 0 to 1000; the mean takes the rest.
